title: Dan's Chaos Mod
description:
Adds many new tools, blocks and more to the vanilla minecraft game!
New Pride and Signs update!
body:
Dan’s Chaos Mod adds a chaotic blend of tech, industry, and radioactive madness to Minecraft, introducing lithium, uranium, oil, plastic, molten metals, emerald tools, advanced crafting materials, and full nuclear reactor systems. 
With the new Natural Life and Food Update, 
Cook with olive oil, salt, pepperoni, cheese and olives as well as tomatoes and dough! (you know that you can cook pizza?)
Added my (The Dev's) pet cat IRL in Minecraft! I hope you enjoy having him as your pet in the game as much as i do but in real life! (also he has some insane knockback and is quite immortal)
Added mediterranian biome
Added new flowers such as Great Rhododendron and chamomile +tea, olive trees and tomato plants 
Added Sus Totem (Still in development)
**Pride Month Update!**
(+) Added Pride Flag signs, general signs and a pizza box?
(👀🎱) **BIG** Update coming soon with something to do with... utilities?!
